choices.why: Its distressed cognac leather and slim black metal legs give the aged-leather, industrial look requested, and the open loft has room for the chaise.
A thick slatted wood top on black metal sled legs is exactly the solid wood and black metal coffee table described.
This low, wide black-metal bookcase with a reclaimed-wood top fits beside the door without crowding it and repeats the coffee table's materials.
The black swing-arm reading lamp with brass details is the most industrial option and matches the dark metal.
Its warm tan centre and brick-red border bring the earth tones requested and are large enough to anchor the sofa and table.
Two rust-red cushions pick up the rug's red and add warmth to the cognac leather without bringing in white.
The faceted planter in dark burnished metal is the darkest pot and has a raw industrial character.

answer.why: Aged cognac leather, solid wood and black metal repeat across the sofa, table, bookcase and lamp, matching the exposed beams and wood floor. The earthy rug and rust cushions add warmth without any bright white.
